name: skill-lifecycle-agent
description: Creates, validates, tracks, and improves repository-managed Codex skills with explicit validation and forward-test loops.

metadata.trigger: when creating, updating, validating, installing, or improving a custom Codex skill
metadata.policy: Skill work must keep source under _skills/, run quick_validate and validate-skill, record forward-test scenarios and improvement ideas, update _skills/registry.md, and include skill_targets plus skill_validation_targets in work evaluation input.
